findings.title: Drupal Core SA-CORE-2026-004 Pre-Announced Highly Critical Patch Releasing 2026-05-20 — NIST score 20/25
findings.affected_technology: Drupal core (11.3.x / 11.2.x / 10.6.x / 10.5.x; manual patches for EOL 8.9 / 9.5)
findings.summary: Drupal Security Team pre-announced a highly critical core patch (NIST 20/25) releasing 2026-05-20 17:00-21:00 UTC — trivially easy to exploit, no privileges required, exposes/modifies all non-public data; exploit development expected within hours/days.

findings.title: SEPPMail Secure E-Mail Gateway CVE-2026-2743 (CVSS 10.0) Path-Traversal RCE + CVE-2026-44125 (9.3) Missing-Authz + CVE-2026-7864 (6.9) Info Leak
findings.affected_technology: SEPPMail Secure E-Mail Gateway (User Web Interface + GINA UI)
findings.summary: InfoGuard Labs disclosed a 3-CVE batch on email gateway widely deployed in DACH enterprise: CVE-2026-2743 path-traversal-to-arbitrary-file-write yields full-appliance Perl reverse shell via /etc/syslog.conf overwrite; patches in 15.0.4.

findings.title: Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 3 — 600+ npm Packages Compromised via @antv/atool Maintainer + Sigstore Provenance Abuse
findings.affected_technology: npm ecosystem (@antv family, timeago.js, third-party transitive dependencies)
findings.summary: Socket/Aikido/Wiz disclosed 639 malicious versions across 323 packages published in 1 hour from compromised atool npm maintainer; novel primitive is generation of valid Sigstore provenance attestations via OIDC token abuse, defeating the recommended npm trust-verification layer.

findings.title: Apache OFBiz 17-CVE Mass Advisory — Multiple Unauth and Authenticated RCE / Auth-Bypass / SSTI Vulnerabilities
findings.summary: Apache OFBiz shipped a 17-CVE batch including CVE-2026-31986 unauth RCE via default JWT signing key, CVE-2026-45434 auth-bypass-to-RCE, and CVE-2026-41919 LDAP-injection auth bypass — mirrors prior CVE-2024-45195 KEV pattern.

findings.title: Microsoft DCU Disrupts 'Fox Tempest' Malware-Signing-as-a-Service — 1,000+ Fraudulent Code-Signing Certs Revoked; Ransomware Affiliate Cluster Identified
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Artifact Signing service (abused by attacker MSaaS) + downstream Windows code-signing trust
findings.summary: Microsoft DCU disrupted Fox Tempest MSaaS abusing Microsoft Artifact Signing; signspace.cloud seized, 1000+ certs revoked, ransomware affiliates Vanilla Tempest / Storm-0501 / Storm-2561 / Storm-0249 confirmed.

findings.title: Apache Tomcat Tribes CVE-2026-34486 EncryptInterceptor Fail-Open Bypass — Public PoC Released 2026-05-19; Unauth RCE via Java Deserialization
findings.summary: Public PoC for Tomcat Tribes EncryptInterceptor fail-open regression appeared on GitHub 2026-05-19 (striga-ai / 404-src repos); attacker bytes forwarded to Java ObjectInputStream on decryption failure yields unauth RCE on cluster receiver port (default 4000) when gadget chains are on the classpath.

findings.title: Panabit PAP-XM320 CVE-2026-36829 (CVSS 9.8) — Unauthenticated HTTP Server Auth Bypass via Session-Cookie + Directory Traversal
findings.affected_technology: Panabit PAP-XM320 network appliance (v7.7 and earlier)
findings.summary: OpenCVE surfaced CVE-2026-36829 — unauth auth-bypass via session-cookie validation failure plus directory-traversal in Panabit (Chinese DPI/traffic-management appliance); deployment skewed to APAC carriers but worth inventory for any organization with the appliance.

findings.title: PenPot MCP REPL CVE-2026-45805 Unauthenticated RCE + MCP Gateway Authority-Injection (GHSA-g53w-w6mj-hrpp)
findings.summary: Two more MCP-server-class issues on GitHub Advisory Database 2026-05-19: PenPot MCP REPL exposes unauthenticated /execute endpoint for code execution; MCP Gateway has JWT/session bypass via unauthenticated router — 8+ MCP server CVEs in 60 days.

findings.title: Coder PKCS#7 Signature Bypass CVE-2026-46354 — Azure Instance Identity Validation Yields Unauthenticated Agent Token Theft
findings.affected_technology: Coder (Go-based self-hosted Cloud Development Environment platform)
findings.summary: Coder fixed PKCS#7 signature bypass in Azure-instance-identity validation; unauth attackers steal agent tokens granting access to dev workspaces — joins broader dev-platform credential-theft surface (Anodot 05-07, Braintrust 05-08, Anthropic Code MCP 05-07).

noted.summary: DirtyDecrypt LPE — public PoC released 2026-05-19 via page-cache corruption in rxgk; LPE-only currently but per MEMORY pattern Linux page-cache LPE bugs become K8s container-escape primitives within 14 days. Watch for KEV add.
Dashboard Server unauth OS command injection (CVSS 9.8) on industrial cobot controller; patched 5.25.1; out of scope for our public-facing inventory but worth noting for OT/industrial-adjacent teams.
JWT-token exposure via Kubernetes provider; widely deployed Airflow but no confirmed exploitation; monitor for patch adoption and any active scanning.
SSRF via hostname hijacking in Angular SSR; in-scope (widely deployed Angular SSR), no exploitation reported; standard SSRF mitigations apply.
Parser resource-exhaustion and recursive stack overflow; lint/DevOps tooling, narrow blast radius.
Local root privilege escalation via command socket; LPE-only, present on non-trivial fraction of Linux servers but no remote vector.
Command injection in document viewers (oss-security 2026-05-19); client desktop, out of scope per Watchtower scope rules.
6 CVEs including open redirect, file upload, CSRF; narrow deployment, no exploitation reported, monitor.
New variant spoofing Apple security updates via AppleScript (BleepingComputer 2026-05-19); client-side macOS, out of scope per Watchtower scope rules.
201 arrests / 53 servers seized in MENA region targeting phishing and malware infrastructure; law-enforcement disruption, not a vulnerability advisory.

noted.product: Discord default-on E2EE for voice/video calls
noted.summary: Product feature rollout enabling default end-to-end encryption for all voice and video calls (BleepingComputer 2026-05-19); defensive positive but not a vulnerability advisory.
4.6 million stolen credit cards released freely allegedly due to seller misconduct; marketplace dump, not a vulnerability — calibration data point on stolen-card market dynamics.
DoS via specially crafted deployment requests; OpenStack Ironic; DoS-only, lower priority than OFBiz RCE batch.
